mapper.insert: INSERT INTO batch (batchNo, goodsCode, productionDate, expiryDate, batchQuantity, remainingQuantity, warehouseCode, status, createTime, updateTime, isDeleted) VALUES (#{batchNo}, #{goodsCode}, #{productionDate}, #{expiryDate}, #{batchQuantity}, #{remainingQuantity}, #{warehouseCode}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{isDeleted})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM batch WHERE isDeleted = 0
SELECT * FROM batch WHERE isDeleted = 0 AND expiryDate IS NOT NULL AND expiryDate BETWEEN NOW() AND DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
SELECT * FROM batch WHERE isDeleted = 0 AND expiryDate IS NOT NULL AND expiryDate BETWEEN NOW() AND DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) ORDER BY expiryDate ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE batch SET status = '过期', updateTime = NOW() WHERE isDeleted = 0 AND status = '正常' AND expiryDate IS NOT NULL AND expiryDate < NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM batch WHERE isDeleted = 0 AND status = '过期' AND expiryDate IS NOT NULL AND expiryDate < NOW() ORDER BY expiryDate ASC

SELECT b.batchNo AS batchNo, g.goodsCode AS goodsCode, g.goodsName AS goodsName, b.batchQuantity AS batchQuantity, b.remainingQuantity AS remainingQuantity, b.expiryDate AS expiryDate FROM batch b LEFT JOIN goods g ON b.goodsCode = g.goodsCode WHERE b.isDeleted = 0 ORDER BY b.remainingQuantity ASC

SELECT CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(b.expiryDate, NOW()) <= 0 THEN '已过期' WHEN DATEDIFF(b.expiryDate, NOW()) <= 7 THEN '7天内' WHEN DATEDIFF(b.expiryDate, NOW()) <= 30 THEN '30天内' ELSE '30天后' END AS period, COUNT(b.id) AS count FROM batch b WHERE b.isDeleted = 0 AND b.expiryDate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(b.expiryDate, NOW()) <= 0 THEN '已过期' WHEN DATEDIFF(b.expiryDate, NOW()) <= 7 THEN '7天内' WHEN DATEDIFF(b.expiryDate, NOW()) <= 30 THEN '30天内' ELSE '30天后' END
